codex_contract.preserved_semantics: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives the real user surface, records observable evidence, and hands maintenance to a verification loop.

native_mapping.fallback: Missing harness, broken startup, or unavailable native surface preserves the source and returns a blocked verification result.
native_mapping.availability: renderer, real disposable CLI verification fixture, project-local .agents/skills/verify-<app>/ structure, syntax/version/health Doctor, per-feature drives, captured stdout/stderr/exit evidence, explicit cleanup ownership, unsafe-input guards, and a disposable local web UI driven through the native Codex in-app browser after an escalated localhost launch; production/live target application and full harness remain unproven
native_mapping.routing_authority: proof-orchestrator selects the proof path; model-capability-router remains the standing model authority

external_dependencies: target application runtime or supplied harness
permission_gates: Write only to an explicit project-local .agents/skills/verify-<app>/ destination; never write a global skill from this flow.
Run the generated instructions only against an instance started by the verification run, and never kill by process name.
Missing harness or broken startup preserves the source and fails verification.
Do not publish, open a PR, or mutate product code as part of generation without separate explicit authorization.

behavioral_proof.positive: A disposable Python CLI runs syntax/version/health Doctor checks, drives each mapped notes CLI feature as a separate subprocess, captures stdout/stderr/exit and regular-file side effects, cleans only declared app state, then creates a project-local .agents/skills/verify-<app>/ with Launch/Doctor/Drive/Evidence/Cleanup/Helpers, a feature-map README, required feature headings, and persisted JSON evidence. A separate disposable local web UI was driven through the native Codex in-app browser for create, search-match, no-match, clear, reload/persistence, with accessibility-tree and screenshot evidence. The result remains `FIXTURE_ONLY`: the disposable UI is not production/live target parity.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: Isolated fixture returns blocked when the verification app is unavailable and performs no product edit.
behavioral_proof.error: The CLI fixture blocks when the app is unavailable or syntax/version/health Doctor fails, rejects a pre-existing cleanup path or unsafe slug, and returns an explicit error for a drive evidence mismatch before writing the skill. Live startup/target health remains unproven.

upstream_readme.note: Verified in the pinned upstream clone; the README is referenced for provenance and is not vendored in this skills-only snapshot.

security_review.decision: Keep the source finding and provenance; do not dismiss it because the adapter adds a warning.

codex_note:
## Codex adaptation boundary

This mirror uses the native Codex project-local skill root `.agents/skills/verify-<app>/`. It discovers the real surface from the repository, selects the proof path through proof-orchestrator, and respects the selected model and effort through model-capability-router. The native verification runner is required for a verified result. If the harness or startup is missing, preserve the project and report `blocked`. Generation never installs a global skill, publishes an artifact, opens a PR, kills by process name, or changes product code. The feature-map references intentionally retain the reproducible upstream `control-notes` commands; adapt them to concrete commands observed in the target repository before use. Map browser/Electron/web actions to `cursor-control-ui`, and CLI/TUI actions to `cursor-control-cli`, only when those skills are installed and applicable; otherwise record the exact surface gap. The bounded CLI fixture uses separate subprocesses, runs syntax/version/health Doctor checks, drives each mapped feature, captures stdout/stderr/exit plus regular-file side effects, cleans only declared app state, and writes only the explicit project-local skill tree. A separate disposable local web fixture was driven through the native Codex in-app browser with accessibility-tree and screenshot evidence; this still does not claim production/live target or native-host verification.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives your app the way a user does — any language, framework, or platform. Use for /create-verification-skill, "make a control skill for this repo", or when a project has no scripted way to prove UI/CLI/service behavior.
proof: Pinned source hash and deterministic renderer are static provenance. Focused tests render the held candidate and run a disposable Python CLI subprocess with syntax/version/health Doctor, one drive per mapped feature, captured stdout/stderr/exit evidence, explicit cleanup, and persisted JSON. A separate disposable local web fixture was driven through the native Codex in-app browser, proving create/search/empty/clear/reload behavior with accessibility-tree and screenshot evidence. The test preserves evidence after app-state cleanup, rejects pre-existing cleanup state and unsafe names, introduces controlled feature drift, and passes a second clean execution. Filesystem/network isolation, live harness, production target application, and native host activation remain unproven; result remains `FIXTURE_ONLY`.
reason: The adapter changes the generated destination and tool boundary while leaving the pinned upstream source unchanged.
